column1: # Planted blocks. NONE OF THESE IS A BLOCK FROM contents/ -- that is the point:
# a control drawn from the enumeration the instrument was built from cannot say
# whether the instrument works, only that it is consistent.
# Expected, and RE-RUN WHENEVER THE COMPILATION STRUCTURE IS TOUCHED:
#   Plant_Leak_B        FAILED   1   CS0246      <-- the one that guards obligation 8
# Plant_Leak_B is the guard. It names a type declared by Plant_Leak_A, in a
# namespace they share, and it must NOT resolve: the two are different blocks.
# Put every block in one compilation and it resolves, and Plant_Leak_B comes
# back BUILT -- a false clean, with nothing in the output to say so. Measured
# id  page  ordinal  shape  n_usings  n_open  n_rest  scaffold
